source: Round 6: the shipped 20-inject.js and cronosjs 1.7.1 (gateway copies) on Node 20.18.3 real timers with virtual time and a FIFO setImmediate router (node-inject-delivery.js, from Sol round-5 node-inject.js); runs recorded at delivery; a throw escaping a timer callback exits (EXIT) and a respawn variant boots again 10 s later. Committed subset: 5 base histories x 33 faults (next, rearm, handler, oncearm) with their respawn variants, and the 56 round-5 review placements
